reporting survey results from 1986 and asserting that "fear of liability exposure and of litigation in general is damaging . . . efforts at volunteer recruitment"
noting, and recommending legislative abrogation of, the majority rule
as of 2002, "doomsday predictions of runaway liability for recreational sports leagues" have not been borne out in practice

"Courts generally agree that one may not exonerate himself or herself from liability for willful or wanton misconduct, for gross negligence, or for intentional torts, even if there is broad exculpatory language"
